```{r}
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)
library(enrichplot)
library(clusterProfiler)
```

```{r}
#######################################################################################################################################################################################
######################################################################Epiphytic vs Apoplastic (Reference-Apoplastic)###################################################################
#######################################################################################################################################################################################
############################################################
#Set Working directory and load the files
############################################################
setwd("~/Library/CloudStorage/Box-Box/Pathogen transcriptomics manuscript/DeSeq_Values_for_WGCNA/Final DeSeq and KEGG analysis/Epi_vs_Apo")
Apo_AL65_24h_rep1 <- read.table("Apo_AL65_24h_rep1.read_count", row.names = 1)
Apo_AL65_24h_rep2 <- read.table("Apo_AL65_24h_rep2.read_count", row.names = 1)
Apo_AL65_24h_rep3 <- read.table("Apo_AL65_24h_rep3.read_count", row.names = 1)
Apo_AL65_72h_rep1 <- read.table("Apo_AL65_72h_rep1.read_count", row.names = 1)
Apo_AL65_72h_rep2 <- read.table("Apo_AL65_72h_rep2.read_count", row.names = 1)
Apo_AL65_72h_rep3 <- read.table("Apo_AL65_72h_rep3.read_count", row.names = 1)
Epi_AL65_8h_rep1 <- read.table("Epi_AL65_8h_rep1.read_count", row.names = 1)
Epi_AL65_8h_rep2 <- read.table("Epi_AL65_8h_rep2.read_count", row.names = 1)
Epi_AL65_8h_rep3 <- read.table("Epi_AL65_8h_rep3.read_count", row.names = 1)
Epi_AL65_24h_rep1 <- read.table("Epi_AL65_24h_rep1.read_count", row.names = 1)
Epi_AL65_24h_rep2 <- read.table("Epi_AL65_24h_rep2.read_count", row.names = 1)
Epi_AL65_24h_rep3 <- read.table("Epi_AL65_24h_rep3.read_count", row.names = 1)

############################################################
# Combine all count tables
############################################################
My_experiment <- cbind(
  Apo_AL65_24h_rep1, Apo_AL65_24h_rep2, Apo_AL65_24h_rep3,
  Apo_AL65_72h_rep1, Apo_AL65_72h_rep2, Apo_AL65_72h_rep3,
  Epi_AL65_8h_rep1,  Epi_AL65_8h_rep2,  Epi_AL65_8h_rep3,
  Epi_AL65_24h_rep1, Epi_AL65_24h_rep2, Epi_AL65_24h_rep3
)

colnames(My_experiment) <- c(
  "Apo_24h_r1","Apo_24h_r2","Apo_24h_r3",
  "Apo_72h_r1","Apo_72h_r2","Apo_72h_r3",
  "Epi_8h_r1","Epi_8h_r2","Epi_8h_r3",
  "Epi_24h_r1","Epi_24h_r2","Epi_24h_r3"
)

colData_My_experiment <- data.frame(
  row.names = colnames(My_experiment),
  condition = c(
    rep("Apo", 6),
    rep("Epi", 6)
  ),
  time = c(
    rep("24h", 3), rep("72h", 3),
    rep("8h", 3),  rep("24h", 3)
  ),
  replica = rep(c("1","2","3"), 4)
)

```

```{r}
############################################################
# Make Deseq Matrix
############################################################
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = My_experiment,
  colData = colData_My_experiment,
  design = ~ condition
)
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref = "Apo")  # Apoplastic as baseline
dds <- DESeq(dds)

res <- results(dds, contrast = c("condition", "Epi", "Apo"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(res), "Epiphytic_vs_Apoplastic.csv")
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Make Deseq Matrix with Time as a factor
############################################################
dds_time <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = My_experiment,
  colData = colData_My_experiment,
  design = ~ time + condition
)
dds_time$condition <- relevel(dds_time$condition, ref = "Apo")
dds_time <- DESeq(dds_time)

res <- results(dds_time, contrast = c("condition", "Epi", "Apo"))
write.csv(as.data.frame(res), "Epiphytic_vs_Apoplastic_timecorrected.csv")
```

```{r}
############################################################
# For PCA Plot
############################################################
rld <- rlog(dds_time, blind = FALSE)
data <- plotPCA(rld, intgroup = c("condition", "time"), returnData = TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(data, "percentVar"))

pcaplot <- ggplot(data, aes(PC1, PC2, color = condition, shape = time)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Apo" = "tomato", "Epi" = "steelblue"))
pcaplot
ggsave("PCA_samples_Epi_vs_Apo.pdf", pcaplot, width=6, height=5)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# For Volcano plot
############################################################
res_df <- as.data.frame(res)
res_df$gene <- rownames(res_df)
res_df$threshold <- ifelse(
  res_df$padj < 0.05 & abs(res_df$log2FoldChange) >= 1,
  ifelse(res_df$log2FoldChange > 1, "Up", "Down"),
  "NS"
)

volcanoplot <-ggplot(res_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = -log10(padj), color = threshold)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "firebrick", "Down" = "dodgerblue", "NS" = "gray70")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  xlab("Log2 Fold Change (Epi vs Apo)") +
  ylab("-Log10 Adjusted p-value") +
  ggtitle("Volcano Plot: Epiphytic vs Apoplastic")
volcanoplot 
ggsave("Volcanoplot_Epi_vs_Apo.pdf", volcanoplot, width=6, height=5)
```


```{r}
############################################################
# Prepare DEG lists
############################################################
deg <- res_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

up_genes <- deg %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% pull(gene)
down_genes <- deg %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% pull(gene)

cat("DEGs: up =", length(up_genes), "down =", length(down_genes), "\n")

if (length(up_genes) == 0 & length(down_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No DEGs found with the chosen thresholds.")
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Read EggNOG-mapper output & build mappings
############################################################
eggnog_file <- "eggnog_output.xlsx"
if (!file.exists(eggnog_file)) stop("EggNOG file not found")

eggnog <- readxl::read_excel(eggnog_file)

# Detect columns automatically
kegg_col <- grep("KEGG_ko$|KEGG.*KO|KO$", colnames(eggnog), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
go_col   <- grep("^GOs$|GO", colnames(eggnog), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]

if (is.na(kegg_col)) stop("No KEGG KO column found in EggNOG file")
if (is.na(go_col)) message("GO column not found → GO enrichment skipped")

# Ensure query_name column exists
eggnog <- eggnog %>% rename(query_name = 1)

```

```{r}
############################################################
# KO extraction with FIX: strip 'ko:' prefix
############################################################

ko_map <- eggnog %>%
  select(query_name, !!sym(kegg_col)) %>%
  rename(KEGG_ko = !!sym(kegg_col)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ko), KEGG_ko != "-", KEGG_ko != "") %>%
  mutate(KEGG_ko = str_replace_all(KEGG_ko, "\\s+", "")) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ko, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ko = str_trim(KEGG_ko),
    KEGG_ko = str_remove(KEGG_ko, "^ko:")
  ) %>%
  filter(KEGG_ko != "")
```


```{r}
############################################################
# 6) Build KO lists for up/down DEGs
############################################################

up_ko <- ko_map %>% filter(query_name %in% up_genes) %>% pull(KEGG_ko) %>% unique()
down_ko <- ko_map %>% filter(query_name %in% down_genes) %>% pull(KEGG_ko) %>% unique()

cat("Mapped KOs: up =", length(up_ko), "down =", length(down_ko), "\n")
```


```{r}
############################################################
# KEGG enrichment (KO-based)
############################################################
kegg_up <- NULL
kegg_down <- NULL

if (length(up_ko) > 0) {
  kegg_up <- tryCatch(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene = up_ko,
      organism = "ko",
      keyType = "kegg",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("KEGG up error: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
}

if (length(down_ko) > 0) {
  kegg_down <- tryCatch(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene = down_ko,
      organism = "ko",
      keyType = "kegg",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("KEGG down error: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
}
```


```{r}
############################################################
# Save enrichment results
############################################################
if (!is.null(kegg_up)   && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_up)) > 0)   write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_up),   "KEGG_up_results.csv",   row.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(kegg_down) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_down)) > 0) write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_down), "KEGG_down_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Plotting
############################################################

library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
safe_plot_save <- function(expr, filename, width = 8, height = 6) {
  tryCatch({
    pdf(filename, width, height)
    print(expr)
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e){
    try(ifelse(dev.cur() > 1, dev.off(), NULL), silent=TRUE)
    message("Plot error: ", e$message)
  })
}

# KEGG
if (!is.null(kegg_up) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_up)) > 0) {
  safe_plot_save(dotplot(kegg_up), "KEGG_up_dotplot.pdf")
  safe_plot_save(barplot(kegg_up), "KEGG_up_barplot.pdf")
}

if (!is.null(kegg_down) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_down)) > 0) {
  safe_plot_save(dotplot(kegg_down), "KEGG_down_dotplot.pdf")
  safe_plot_save(barplot(kegg_down), "KEGG_down_barplot.pdf")
}
```


```{r}
############################################################
# 10) Adding locus_tag or query name to Kegg up or down
############################################################
add_locus_to_kegg <- function(kegg_obj, ko_map) {

  if (is.null(kegg_obj) || nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_obj)) == 0) return(NULL)

  kegg_df <- as.data.frame(kegg_obj)

  out <- kegg_df %>%
    mutate(KEGG_ko = strsplit(geneID, "/")) %>%
    unnest(KEGG_ko) %>%
    left_join(
      ko_map %>% select(KEGG_ko, query_name) %>% distinct(),
      by = "KEGG_ko"
    ) %>%
    rename(locus_tag = query_name)

  return(out)
}

# ---------- UP ----------
kegg_up_with_locus <- add_locus_to_kegg(kegg_up, ko_map)

if (!is.null(kegg_up_with_locus)) {
  write.csv(
    kegg_up_with_locus,
    "KEGG_up_results_WITH_locus_tag.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

# ---------- DOWN ----------
kegg_down_with_locus <- add_locus_to_kegg(kegg_down, ko_map)

if (!is.null(kegg_down_with_locus)) {
  write.csv(
    kegg_down_with_locus,
    "KEGG_down_results_WITH_locus_tag.csv",
    row.names = FALSE
  )
}

```

```{r}
############################################################
# Combine all count tables
############################################################
My_experiment<-cbind(Apo_AL65_24h_rep1, Apo_AL65_24h_rep2, Apo_AL65_24h_rep3, Apo_AL65_72h_rep1, Apo_AL65_72h_rep2, Apo_AL65_72h_rep3)

colnames(My_experiment)<- c("Apo_AL65_24h_rep1","Apo_AL65_24h_rep2","Apo_AL65_24h_rep3","Apo_AL65_72h_rep1", "Apo_AL65_72h_rep2","Apo_AL65_72h_rep3")

  row.names = colnames(My_experiment),
  replica = c("1","2","3","1","2","3"),
  condition = factor(c("Apo_AL65_24h","Apo_AL65_24h","Apo_AL65_24h",
                       "Apo_AL65_72h","Apo_AL65_72h","Apo_AL65_72h"))
  
)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Make Deseq Matrix
############################################################
dds <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = My_experiment,
                              colData = colData_My_experiment,
                              design = ~ condition)

# Set reference
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref="Apo_AL65_24h")

# Run DESeq
dds2 <- DESeq(dds)

# Extract results
res <- results(dds2)
write.csv(as.data.frame(res), file = "AL65_72h_vs_Apo_AL65_24h_results.csv")

# Save normalized counts
write.csv(counts(dds2, normalized = TRUE), file = "Apo_normalized_counts.csv")
```

```{r}
dds$condition <- relevel(dds$condition, ref="Epi_AL65_8h")
dds2 <- DESeq(dds)
res <- results(dds2)
write.csv(as.data.frame(res), file = "Epi_AL65_24h_VS_Epi_AL65_8h_results.csv")
write.csv(counts(dds2, normalized = TRUE), file = "normalized_counts.csv")
```

```{r}
deg <- res_df %>%

  filter(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) >= 1)

up_genes <- deg %>% filter(log2FoldChange > 0) %>% pull(gene)
down_genes <- deg %>% filter(log2FoldChange < 0) %>% pull(gene)

cat("DEGs: up =", length(up_genes), "down =", length(down_genes), "\n")

if (length(up_genes) == 0 & length(down_genes) == 0) {
  stop("No DEGs found with the chosen thresholds.")
}
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Read EggNOG-mapper output & build mappings
############################################################

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

eggnog_file <- "eggnog_output.xlsx"
if (!file.exists(eggnog_file)) stop("EggNOG file not found")

eggnog <- readxl::read_excel(eggnog_file)

# Detect columns automatically
kegg_col <- grep("KEGG_ko$|KEGG.*KO|KO$", colnames(eggnog), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
go_col   <- grep("^GOs$|GO", colnames(eggnog), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]

if (is.na(kegg_col)) stop("No KEGG KO column found in EggNOG file")
if (is.na(go_col)) message("GO column not found → GO enrichment skipped")

# Ensure query_name column exists
eggnog <- eggnog %>% rename(query_name = 1)

```

```{r}
############################################################
# KO extraction with FIX: strip 'ko:' prefix
############################################################
ko_map <- eggnog %>%
  select(query_name, !!sym(kegg_col)) %>%
  rename(KEGG_ko = !!sym(kegg_col)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(KEGG_ko), KEGG_ko != "-", KEGG_ko != "") %>%
  mutate(KEGG_ko = str_replace_all(KEGG_ko, "\\s+", "")) %>%
  separate_rows(KEGG_ko, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(
    KEGG_ko = str_trim(KEGG_ko),
    KEGG_ko = str_remove(KEGG_ko, "^ko:")
  ) %>%
  filter(KEGG_ko != "")
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Build KO lists for up/down DEGs
############################################################
up_ko <- ko_map %>% filter(query_name %in% up_genes) %>% pull(KEGG_ko) %>% unique()
down_ko <- ko_map %>% filter(query_name %in% down_genes) %>% pull(KEGG_ko) %>% unique()

cat("Mapped KOs: up =", length(up_ko), "down =", length(down_ko), "\n")
```


```{r}
############################################################
# KEGG enrichment (KO-based)
############################################################
kegg_up <- NULL
kegg_down <- NULL

if (length(up_ko) > 0) {
  kegg_up <- tryCatch(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene = up_ko,
      organism = "ko",
      keyType = "kegg",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("KEGG up error: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
}

if (length(down_ko) > 0) {
  kegg_down <- tryCatch(
    enrichKEGG(
      gene = down_ko,
      organism = "ko",
      keyType = "kegg",
      pvalueCutoff = 0.05
    ),
    error = function(e) { message("KEGG down error: ", e$message); NULL }
  )
}
```


```{r}
############################################################
# Save enrichment results
############################################################
if (!is.null(kegg_up)   && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_up)) > 0)   write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_up),   "KEGG_up_results.csv",   row.names = FALSE)
if (!is.null(kegg_down) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_down)) > 0) write.csv(as.data.frame(kegg_down), "KEGG_down_results.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
############################################################
# Plotting
############################################################
safe_plot_save <- function(expr, filename, width = 8, height = 6) {
  tryCatch({
    pdf(filename, width, height)
    print(expr)
    dev.off()
  }, error = function(e){
    try(ifelse(dev.cur() > 1, dev.off(), NULL), silent=TRUE)
    message("Plot error: ", e$message)
  })
}

# KEGG
if (!is.null(kegg_up) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_up)) > 0) {
  safe_plot_save(dotplot(kegg_up), "KEGG_up_dotplot.pdf")
  safe_plot_save(barplot(kegg_up), "KEGG_up_barplot.pdf")
}

if (!is.null(kegg_down) && nrow(as.data.frame(kegg_down)) > 0) {
  safe_plot_save(dotplot(kegg_down), "KEGG_down_dotplot.pdf")
  safe_plot_save(barplot(kegg_down), "KEGG_down_barplot.pdf")
}
```
